arena_context_desc: high speed physics simulation on a pure pitch black obsidian arena with two distinct glowing elemental spheres facing each other on left and right
static_hold_desc: two large stationary glowing elemental spheres facing each other quietly across a pitch black void without any attacks
negative_desc: text, letters, watermark, logo, human, face, white background, blurry, disappearing both spheres

p_pyro_melee.action_desc: charges rightward and sweeps a blazing fire blade into the right sphere

p_hydro_ranged.action_desc: blasts a high-pressure stream of blue water bolts across the arena into the right sphere

p_electro_mage.action_desc: channels an unbroken crackling lightning beam directly onto the right sphere

p_cryo_melee.action_desc: lunges rightward slashing a crystalline ice blade into the right sphere

npc_hydro_melee.action_desc: dashes leftward lashing a swirling water whip directly into the left sphere

npc_geo_ranged.action_desc: hurls a barrage of glowing emerald rock projectiles leftward into the left sphere

npc_pyro_mage.action_desc: ignites a roaring fire pillar directly over the left sphere

npc_cryo_ranged.action_desc: fires a volley of piercing ice lances leftward into the left sphere

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: both elemental spheres clash evenly in the center of the black arena
quest.completed_hypothesis: the left sphere's elemental attack overwhelms and shatters the right sphere in bright sparks
quest.failed_hypothesis: the right sphere's elemental attack overwhelms and shatters the left sphere in bright sparks
